variable_coverage.construction: Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the outside director leaves the restating company board within three years of the restatement announcement/year, and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1 if the director leaves within three years of the restatement; 0 otherwise..

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the director is a member of the firm’s audit committee, and 0 otherwise. The reference date for membership is not separately stated. Formula/construction: 1 if audit committee member; 0 otherwise..
Source definition: Number of quarters for which net income is restated. Formula/construction: Count of restated quarters..
Source definition: Product of AUDIT COMM, equal to 1 for an audit committee member and 0 otherwise, and DURATION, the model’s severity measure. Formula/construction: AUDIT COMM × DURATION.

Source definition: Firm stock return over the same three-year window used to measure DEPARTURE or OTHER DIRECTOR LOSS, less the CRSP value-weighted return over that same window; both returns are continuously compounded before differencing. The source does not specify whether the model input is multiplied by 100; descriptive statistics show percentages. Formula/construction: Continuously compounded firm stock return − continuously compounded CRSP value-weighted return over the corresponding three-year outcome window..
Source definition: Total assets in billions at the year-end before the restatement announcement. Formula/construction: Total assets at prior year-end, in $billions..

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the CEO of the restating company changes within three years of the restatement, and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1 if CEO changes within three years of the restatement; 0 otherwise..
Source definition: Number of directors on the board of the restating company. Measurement date is not separately stated. Formula/construction: Count of directors on the restating company’s board..

Source definition: Board shareholding in the restating company, measured as the percentage of firm equity held by the board as a whole. Measurement date is not separately stated. Formula/construction: 100 × board-held firm equity / total firm equity..

Source definition: Ratio of outside directors to total board size. Measurement date is not separately stated; descriptive statistics report this ratio as a percentage, but regression scaling is not specified. Formula/construction: Outside director count / total board size..

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the CEO is the company’s founder or belongs to the founding family, and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1 if CEO is founder/founding-family member; 0 otherwise..
Source definition: Age of the director in the restatement year. Formula/construction: Director age in the restatement year..

Source definition: Number of years the director has served on the restating company’s board at the restatement announcement. Formula/construction: Years on the restating company board at announcement..

Source definition: Director’s shareholding in the restating company, measured by the percentage of total company equity held by the director. Measurement date is not separately stated. Formula/construction: 100 × director-held firm equity / total firm equity..

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the director is CEO of another public company, and 0 otherwise. Reference date is not separately stated. Formula/construction: 1 if director is CEO of another public company; 0 otherwise..

Source definition: Number of outside-director positions the sample director holds in other public companies, excluding the restating company. The measurement date for this RHS control is not stated. Formula/construction: Count of outside-director positions in public companies other than the restating company..

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the director is a financial expert under the SEC Standards Relating to Listed Company Audit Committee definition, and 0 otherwise. The paper references the SEC definition but does not reproduce its criteria. Formula/construction: 1 if financial expert under the cited SEC definition; 0 otherwise..
Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the director joined the board after the CEO, and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1 if director joined board after CEO; 0 otherwise..

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the director was a net seller of the company’s stock during the misstatement period, and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1 if net seller during misstatement period; 0 otherwise..
